gold: Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19) with Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS)

selector.rationale: Nasopharyngeal swab positive by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction and symptoms of fever, anosmia, and shortness of breath

rejected.label: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome (ARDS)
rejected.why: While the patient has severe respiratory symptoms, ARDS is not directly supported by the provided laboratory and imaging findings as the primary diagnosis

rejected.label: Obstructive sleep apnea-related hypoxemia
rejected.why: The patient's current presentation is more indicative of an acute infectious process rather than a complication of obstructive sleep apnea

rejected.label: Obstructive Sleep Apnea-Related Hypoxia
rejected.why: Similar to obstructive sleep apnea-related hypoxemia, the current symptoms and findings are more aligned with an acute infection
